settings.name: Ravi Prakash
settings.heroIntro: I build apps and websites that are fast, clear and easy to live with. Mobile, web, design and testing, handled end to end by one person who cares how it turns out.
settings.aboutBody:
I have strong analytical and research skills, and I like turning complicated subjects into things people can act on.

I have a solid foundation in technology and use it to take part in discussions on emerging issues such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, blockchain and data privacy, assessing how technology affects policy and helping decision-makers navigate it.

I am also trained in data analysis and visualisation, which helps me interpret complex datasets, spot trends and communicate findings to a wider audience.

services.title: Android Development
services.summary: High-quality native and Flutter apps for Android that give users a smooth, engaging experience and help your business grow.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.text: I will design and build an Android application tailored to your requirements: robust, scalable and visually polished, with your brand running through it.

sections.heading: Scope of work
sections.text: UI/UX design for an intuitive interface. Clean, maintainable development. Rigorous testing for functionality, performance and security. Deployment to the Google Play Store and ongoing support.

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.text: Delivery time depends on the size of the project. We agree on milestones up front, and the plan stays flexible as requirements evolve.

sections.heading: Investment
sections.text: Pricing depends on scope and complexity. You get a clear written quote covering design, development, testing and deployment before any work starts.

sections.heading: Why work with me
sections.text: Direct communication with the person doing the work, regular progress updates, on-time delivery and thorough testing before every hand-over.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.text: Send me an enquiry with a short description of what you need. I will reply with questions, a proposed plan and a quote. Work begins after approval and an initial payment of 25%.

services.title: Graphic Design
services.summary: Logos, brand collateral and marketing visuals that turn ideas into clear, memorable visual communication.

sections.heading: About the service
sections.text: I specialise in graphic design with a keen eye for detail, turning ideas into impactful visual communication that fits your brand.

sections.heading: Scope of work
sections.text: Logo design. Branding collateral such as business cards and letterheads. Marketing materials such as brochures, flyers, posters and banners. Digital graphics including social posts, web banners and email templates. Packaging design. Custom illustration.

sections.heading: Design process
sections.text: We start with an in-depth conversation about your vision and goals. I present initial concepts for feedback, then refine until the design matches what you had in mind.

sections.heading: Investment
sections.text: Packages cover all design concepts, revisions and final deliverables. Get in touch for a quote that fits your needs.

sections.heading: Why work with me
sections.text: Creative excellence, a client-first approach, timely delivery and clear communication from first sketch to final files.

services.title: Software Testing
services.summary: Manual and automated testing covering functionality, performance and security, so you ship with confidence.

sections.heading: My approach
sections.text: A systematic, detail-oriented process: analyse the application, find problems, and report them with actionable guidance for fixing them.

sections.heading: Manual testing
sections.text: Hands-on testing to catch usability issues, functional gaps and user-experience problems.

sections.heading: Automated testing
sections.text: Automated test scripts that speed up testing and keep results consistent.

sections.heading: Performance and security
sections.text: Checks on responsiveness, stability and speed under load, plus security assessments to find vulnerabilities.

sections.heading: Regression testing
sections.text: Verification that new changes do not break existing features.

sections.heading: Reporting and pricing
sections.text: You get detailed, transparent reports throughout. Pricing depends on scope and complexity, with a clear breakdown after we discuss your needs.

services.title: Remote Support
services.summary: Fast, friendly technical help delivered remotely: troubleshooting, setup and guidance from wherever you are.

sections.heading: What it covers
sections.text: Diagnosing and resolving software glitches, network issues and hardware problems over chat, email, phone or remote desktop.

sections.heading: How I work
sections.text: I analyse the issue, find the root cause and apply an effective fix, explaining each step in plain language so you understand what changed.

sections.heading: Tools
sections.text: Remote access tools let me look at the problem directly, apply fixes and guide you through troubleshooting.

sections.heading: Commitment
sections.text: Patient, courteous and focused on getting you working again. Every interaction and solution is documented for future reference.

services.title: Gaming
services.summary: I am RP_Axel: gamer, explorer of virtual worlds and storyteller. Come and play.

sections.heading: Player one
sections.text: I am RP_Axel, a gamer with a long history of exploring virtual worlds, from first-person shooters to open-world RPGs.

sections.heading: The journey
sections.text: It began in the 8-bit era with Mario and Zelda and grew into online multiplayer and competitive eSports.

sections.heading: What drives me
sections.text: The thrill of discovery, the camaraderie of online communities, and the satisfaction of beating a challenge that looked impossible. Gaming taught me teamwork, strategy and perseverance.

sections.heading: Join in
sections.text: Whether you are a fellow gamer, a curious beginner or just want to talk about the latest releases, say hello. Let us level up.
